tools.name: register_trade
tools.description: Sets up a tradesperson's business once, with their name, colours, logo and optional Google review link. Returns a trade_key (save it; every other tool needs it, and it cannot be shown again), the public trade page link, and a nero_trade_ref that carries the history into Nero Work. No human sign-up f

tools.name: update_trade
tools.description: Changes the business details shown on the review pages: name, trade, town, brand colours, logo link or Google review link. Only the fields given change. Returns the trade page link.

tools.name: job_done
tools.description: Call this after EVERY finished job, whether the customer seemed happy or not, for example when the trade says "job done for Mrs Patel". tools.name: export_history
tools.description: Returns the business's full record (every logged job, every rating, the totals in Nero Work's own field names, branding and nero_trade_ref) so the history can be loaded into Nero Work, the agent job exchange for trades, or kept as a backup.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "register_trade" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: my_score, list_reviews, reply_to_review, dispute_review · Private data: register_trade, dispute_review, export_history · Public sink: job_done, reply_to_review, dispute_review · Destructive: reply_to_review.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: my_score, list_reviews, reply_to_review, dispute_review · Private data: register_trade, dispute_review, export_history · Public sink: job_done, reply_to_review, dispute_review · Destructive: reply_to_review

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
